segments.caption: On the 27th of August, 1883, an island in the Sunda Strait began to come apart.
segments.vo: On the twenty seventh of August, eighteen eighty three, an island in the Sunda Strait began to come apart.

segments.caption: The third blast, at 10:02 that morning, is the loudest sound in recorded history.

segments.caption: Forty miles away, the pressure broke men's eardrums.

segments.caption: Inside the strait, it did not arrive as sound at all. It arrived as a wall of air.

segments.caption: 36,417 people died. Most of them were drowned, not burned.

segments.caption: The ash went higher, fifty miles up, and the sunsets went red.
